applicability.subject: january_anchor_and_event_checks_under_different_player_choices
applicability.finding: The anchor source defines historical observations, not source-conditioned player-choice exemptions. The player contract keeps protected/history gates hard. A waiver or conditional applicability rule needs governing authority and a predeclared condition. RBiH currently passes the measured January subset; RS and HRHB remain unreached.

applicability.subject: farz_gate
applicability.finding: Farz is a week-188 hard gate for all three player campaigns. The accepted rule permits either 2nd or 3rd Corps to make the final blow, requires the four authored late operation capture receipts and RBiH control at week 188, and treats 2nd Corps participation as diagnostic. No retained player campaign reaches it.

applicability.subject: score_700
applicability.finding: The retained t39 score is diagnostic only. It is neither a player floor nor a replacement for hard gates.

sameInput.finding: The actual result contains event-choice receipts and other action-specific records, but no standalone complete ordered action/input/command transcript and no production replay consumer binding. Save/load proves serialization/hydration at one point and cannot establish repeated identical production inputs. Equal seed/autonomy is insufficient because selected-player authorization changes phase inputs.

retiredComparator.finding: native_calibration_outcome_compare reconstructs n94 and compares the player run to it. Its protected set is the 712 cells equal across n91/n92/n94, not the canonical protected-control contract, and it hard-codes the retired score/equality checks. Its health object omits the full engine_health_gate contract. Keep its output diagnostic; do not use it as player pass/fail or protected/health proof.

canonicalReaders.finding: engine_health_gate and verify_checkpoints expect a complete 188-style run directory with run_summary, final_save, weekly reports, operation AARs, and checkpoints. The t39 player artifact shape cannot be qualified by those readers without a source-authorized player reader/adaptor.

crossFactionOpeningPreflight.finding: The harness has faction and historical-selector fixtures, but map counter coverage samples up to 12 formations dynamically from the current runtime and reduces the target to the available sample. It does not establish a frozen required all-faction counter set. Recruitment is enforced only with strategic/auto-recruit/require-recruitment flags, which the t39 command did not use. The harness's built-in required event receipts and historical-event assertions apply only to fresh, non-resume RS runs at target turn 52 or later; they are distinct from the separate retained RBiH t39 post-run reader that checked five January event anchors. The retained RBiH opening proves 11/11 available members of a frozen 12-member RBiH set, with 17th Vitezka unavailable; RBiH-only arguments or fixtures cannot qualify RS or HRHB.

cheapestRejectingNextStep.reuseEvidence: Reuse the unchanged qualified 90-test harness evidence at its existing fixture scope after exact hash confirmation. Do not rerun it for reassurance and do not treat it as replay proof.
prerequisites: Exact retained raw-result and manifest paths and readable JSON
Existing harness, production replay-owner, and test source readable at the retained source state
No historical inference or invented action ordering
passCriteria: Existing source identifies capture and serialization for every state-mutating player action in complete consumed order
An existing production replay path consumes that serialization without reselection
The retained result and manifest bind each required action to actor, faction, turn, selection/receipt, and comparable settled archives
The conclusion follows from explicit source/artifact fields without reconstructing player intent or historical choice
cheapestRejectingNextStep.expectedCost: Seconds to about three minutes of offline Node checks; zero native minutes.
cheapestRejectingNextStep.stoppingRule: Stop as soon as production owner discovery or complete consumed order cannot be established from explicit existing source and retained fields without invention or historical inference. Record SOURCE_OWNER_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED when the bounded owner set is incomplete, otherwise MISSING_REPLAYABLE_INPUT_CONTRACT when the inspected owners do not establish the contract. Do not launch native. Either fail-closed label means this evidence scope is insufficient; neither claims a production bug, proves global absence, or says the input is immutably unrecoverable.

implementationIfFeasibilityFails.need: A source-authorized read-only input-contract reader and, if absent, explicit production capture/serialization/replay-consumer support. No command is specified because no such reader entrypoint currently exists.

laterSeparateOpeningGate.finding: Qualify frozen counter, choice, proposal, reserve, officer, and recruitment expectations separately for RBiH, RS, and HRHB. RBiH-only arguments cannot qualify all three factions. The harness's built-in RS event assertions require a fresh non-resume RS target of at least 52 turns and are not the retained RBiH t39 five-event post-run reader.
